policy: Each probe ran once, as an unchanged existing script, in a tracked subprocess. Raw AEDT/PyAEDT logs are kept in scratch only because they contain licence-server details; error classes are paraphrased from keyword flags over the PyAEDT log and AEDT's batch.log, never copied.

q3d_extractor_dc.model: copper bar 1 x 0.1 x 0.01 mm, source/sink on the end faces, DC only
q3d_extractor_dc.error_class: FlexNet: feature not available -- the solver's licence feature does not exist on the licence server, so AEDT terminated the solve with a licence error; desktop launch and model build were unaffected

maxwell3d_dc_conduction.model: copper bar 1 x 0.1 x 0.01 mm, current/voltage on the end faces
maxwell3d_dc_conduction.error_class: not a licence result: the existing probe script raised an exception before reaching the solve (PyAEDT 1.1 API mismatch in that branch); no licence request for this solver was made
maxwell3d_dc_conduction.note: Not asked for by this re-probe; probe2 simply runs it before Icepak. Its result here is not a licence result (see error_class). The Maxwell DC licence status therefore rests on the earlier probe recorded in aedt_common.py / tool_evidence/README.md and was not re-tested now.
